target_customer: Sports bettors, including serious and professional bettors, who want odds across sportsbooks, positive EV and arbitrage tools
problem: Bettors compare lines across many sportsbooks manually; OddsView offers a Bloomberg style terminal with real time odds, historical charts and EV and arbitrage finders.
business_model: Consumer subscription for betting tools (pricing not confirmed)
product_category: Sports betting data and analytics terminal

founders.name: Davis Tong
prior_employers: Amazon (software engineer, comparison widget data pipeline)
education: Rutgers Honors College, applied science engineering

founders.name: Ajay Koritala
education: Rutgers Honors College, mathematics and computer science

founders.name: Anthony Ter-Saakov
education: Boston University, math degree and master's in statistics

founders.name: Henri Zhang
education: Rutgers Honors College, CS and cognitive science, 2021
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page; later full time sports betting consultant.

competitors.name: OddsJam
competitors.what: Odds comparison and arbitrage and positive EV subscription tool, founded by Stanford students
competitors.traction_then: Active subscription product aggregating odds from hundreds of sportsbooks

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting real time odds from many sportsbooks and storing historical lines at low latency is real data engineering, though standard for the team's backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Sportsbook odds are public feeds; OddsJam and others offered similar tools, and sportsbooks can limit accounts or block scraping.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source reports an acquisition or copy of OddsView.

market_need_then: US sports betting spread across states after 2018 and bettors paid for odds and arbitrage tools; Product Hunt claims thousands of bettors used its feeds (company claim).

branding.domain_note: Used oddsview.com; the site returned HTTP 402 during the check.

identity.visual_style: Terminal and trading screen look inspired by financial market tools
identity.voice_and_tone: Pro trader framing, The Bloomberg Terminal of Sports Betting

branding.brand_signature: The Bloomberg Terminal of Sports Betting tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt page with 37 followers and a launch comment; no merch found

brand_strength.rationale: Clear positioning tagline but a descriptive name near OddsJam and other odds named tools, and limited community evidence.

outcome_analysis: OddsView joined YC in Winter 2024 with five former Amazon and Verkada engineers building a sports betting terminal and raised the standard $500K. The YC page lists it inactive and the website returned an error, but no news, post mortem or founder statement explains the cause, so the cause is not public.
notes: The $500K appears on Caplight (dated 2024-01-01), VCBacked (pre seed, 2024-03), Standout (seed) and CB Insights (convertible note); stage label conflicts so it is recorded as other, and it rests on databases only. Several YC page founders are described by the page but not confirmed by the company site. Exit unknown. oddsview.com returned HTTP 402.
